title: Rust: Observe subscribe/notify
notes: Completed 2026-08-27: added bounded allocation-free RFC 7641 core in rust/lichen-coap/src/observe.rs and public exports. Server API provides fixed-capacity endpoint+token registry, re-registration/deregistration, resource enumeration, atomic exact-wire notification caching, CON retry scheduling with byte reuse, NON one-shot dispatch, ACK retention, RST/retry-exhaustion removal, per-observer backpressure, sequence validation, and idle cleanup. Client API provides bounded subscriptions, registration replacement, 24-bit serial ordering/wrap with explicit half-range ambiguity, RFC 128-second freshness fallback, terminal/cancel/RST handling, non-initial Block2 boundaries, capacity/error atomicity, and timeout cleanup. CoAP option 6 canonical parse/build helpers reject non-minimal/oversized values. Independent focused cases cover canonical option bytes, range/wrap/half-range, capacity, stale/ambiguous rejection, exact retransmit bytes, ACK/RST/retry exhaustion, NON, Block2, terminal response, and cleanup. Validation with unique CARGO_TARGET_DIR: cargo test -p lichen-coap --all-features --tests => 61 unit + 3 RFC vector + 10 Observe + 2 application vector tests passed; cargo check --no-default-features passed; cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings passed; cargo clippy --no-default-features --lib -- -D warnings passed; cargo fmt --check passed. rustdoc completed with four pre-existing broken-link warnings in untouched client.rs. Files intentionally modified: rust/lichen-coap/src/lib.rs, rust/lichen-coap/src/observe.rs, rust/lichen-coap/tests/observe.rs. Pre-existing dirty rust/Cargo.lock and untracked coap_rfc_vectors.rs were not touched.
